scripts.stop: lsof -ti :3333 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || echo 'Port 3333 is free'
scripts.test:prod: URL=$(grep "^VITE_PROXY_URL=" .env.prod | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d "\"\r" ); if [ -z "$URL" ]; then echo "Error: VITE_PROXY_URL not found in .env.prod - refusing to run production tests against a fallback URL" >&2; exit 1; fi; E2E_PROD=1 VITE_PROXY_URL="$URL" playwright test
